+from cerberus import SchemaError, Validator
 from cbc_sdk.base import MutableBaseModel
 from cbc_sdk.errors import ApiError, InvalidObjectError

+_SCHEMA_TYPE_TO_CERBERUS = {
+    'array': 'list',
+    'boolean': 'boolean',
+    'integer': 'integer',
+    'number': 'number',
+    'object': 'dict',
+    'string': 'string',
+}
+
+
+def _schema_type_to_cerberus(json_type):
+    """Translate a JSON schema type into a Cerberus type."""
+    cerberus_type = _SCHEMA_TYPE_TO_CERBERUS.get(json_type)
+    if cerberus_type is None:
+        raise ApiError(f"internal error: '{json_type}' is not valid under any of the given schemas")
+    return cerberus_type
+
+
+def _field_to_cerberus(field_schema):
+    """Translate a JSON schema property definition into a Cerberus rule."""
+    field_schema = dict(field_schema)
+    json_type = field_schema.pop('type', 'string')
+
+    if isinstance(json_type, list):
+        cerberus_rules = [_field_to_cerberus(dict(field_schema, type=field_type))
+                          for field_type in json_type if field_type != 'null']
+        if not cerberus_rules:
+            raise ApiError("internal error: 'null' is not valid under any of the given schemas")
+        if len(cerberus_rules) == 1:
+            cerberus_rule = cerberus_rules[0]
+        else:
+            cerberus_rule = {'anyof': cerberus_rules}
+        if 'null' in json_type:
+            cerberus_rule['nullable'] = True
+        return cerberus_rule
+
+    if json_type == 'object':
+        cerberus_rule = {'type': 'dict', 'allow_unknown': True}
+        properties = field_schema.get('properties', {})
+        if properties:
+            cerberus_rule['schema'] = {name: _field_to_cerberus(value)
+                                       for name, value in properties.items()}
+        return cerberus_rule
+
+    if json_type == 'array':
+        cerberus_rule = {'type': 'list'}
+        items = field_schema.get('items')
+        if items is not None:
+            cerberus_rule['schema'] = _field_to_cerberus(items)
+        return cerberus_rule
+
+    cerberus_rule = {'type': _schema_type_to_cerberus(json_type)}
+    if 'enum' in field_schema:
+        cerberus_rule['allowed'] = field_schema['enum']
+    return cerberus_rule
+
+
+def _value_matches_type(value, json_type):
+    """Return True when *value* satisfies the JSON schema type name."""
+    if json_type == 'array':
+        return isinstance(value, list)
+    if json_type == 'boolean':
+        return isinstance(value, bool)
+    if json_type == 'integer':
+        return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
+    if json_type == 'null':
+        return value is None
+    if json_type == 'number':
+        return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
+    if json_type == 'object':
+        return isinstance(value, dict)
+    if json_type == 'string':
+        return isinstance(value, str)
+    return False
+
+
+def _validation_error(schema, value):
+    """Mirror the JSON schema error text used by the legacy validator."""
+    json_type = schema.get('type', 'string')
+
+    if isinstance(json_type, list):
+        if not any(_value_matches_type(value, field_type) for field_type in json_type):
+            expected_type = next((field_type for field_type in json_type if field_type != 'null'), json_type[0])
+            return f"{value!r} is not of type '{expected_type}'"
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+    elif not _value_matches_type(value, json_type):
+        return f"{value!r} is not of type '{json_type}'"
+
+    if json_type == 'object':
+        for name, subschema in schema.get('properties', {}).items():
+            if name in value:
+                error = _validation_error(subschema, value[name])
+                if error is not None:
+                    return error
+        return None
+
+    if json_type == 'array':
+        items = schema.get('items')
+        if items is not None:
+            for item in value:
+                error = _validation_error(items, item)
+                if error is not None:
+                    return error
+        return None
+
+    enum_values = schema.get('enum')
+    if enum_values is not None and value not in enum_values:
+        return f"{value!r} is not one of {enum_values!r}"
+
+    return None
+
+
+def _parameter_schema_to_cerberus(parameter_schema):
+    """Convert the API's JSON schema shape into a Cerberus schema."""
+    if not isinstance(parameter_schema, dict):
+        raise ApiError('internal error: invalid parameter schema')
+    if parameter_schema.get('type', 'object') != 'object':
+        raise ApiError(f"internal error: '{parameter_schema.get('type')}' is not valid under any of the given schemas")
+    return {name: _field_to_cerberus(value)
+            for name, value in parameter_schema.get('properties', {}).items()}
